cases.taskGoal: Produce a public-facing, evidence-driven plan for a fictional city district using Work-Tree Fork style decomposition and parent synthesis.
cases.currentObjective: Create a final public demonstration report for a fictional city district in this run. Do not stop at a plan and do not ask for clarification. Show how four parallel workstreams feed a parent synthesis: energy storage, emergency communications, budget/procurement, and risk/operations. Use only the provided context; do not claim live web research. Include concrete numbers from the benefit estimate context.

currentContext.title: showcase task brief
currentContext.content: Public demo scenario: design a 2030 resilient energy and emergency communications plan for a fictional district of 180,000 residents, 65 critical facilities, 52% renewable power share, 3-6 GW regional peak load dependency, and a 72-hour resilience target for shelters, clinics, water pumps, and emergency coordination centers.

currentContext.title: fork workstreams
currentContext.content: The four child workstreams are: (1) energy storage and microgrid route comparison; (2) emergency communications and continuity design; (3) budget, procurement, and staged rollout; (4) risk, governance, operations, and drill plan. Parent synthesis must merge child summaries rather than concatenate them.

currentContext.title: benefit estimate metrics
currentContext.content: Benefit estimate baseline: serial work 320 minutes; fork parallel work plus parent merge 133 minutes; estimated wall-clock speedup 2.406x; duplicate-read reduction 33.3%; parent merge overhead ratio 28.6%; evidence coverage 100%. Explain these as evaluation estimates, not measured live wall-clock.

currentContext.title: public delivery format
currentContext.content: Output Markdown for a public demo. Include a compact executive summary, workstream table, evidence metrics table, synthesis plan, risks, and what the live run proves versus what it does not prove.

cases.responseRequirements: Output Markdown only. Deliver the final public demo report now, not a plan. Required headings: ## Executive Summary, ## Workstreams, ## Evidence Metrics, ## Parent Synthesis Plan, ## Risks And Limits, ## What This Live Run Proves. Do not claim real web browsing. Use the numeric benefit estimates exactly as estimates.
